data.why: the repo ships assets/example_spreadsheet.xlsx, a header-free Time+well OD table matching exactly the format utils/file_io.read_data() expects, and the Upload tab's own download button serves this same file

goals: upload a plate-reader OD-vs-time file and confirm it loads correctly into the chosen well layout
subtract blank-well backgrounds from sample wells to get corrected growth curves
detect lag, exponential and stationary growth phases automatically from the corrected curves
fit a logistic, exponential, Baranyi or custom model to the growth data and inspect confidence intervals
define and solve a custom ODE model against the data and compare fitted parameters with uncertainty
reference standard growth-model equations to interpret the fitted curves

review.summary: The tree accurately covers the Basic-Mode path through the tool (load and check the plate, model and subtract blanks, fit growth models over time windows with CIs, export), and most cited screens show what their nodes claim. It leaves out two capabilities the README and plan list, custom ODE fitting and group arithmetic, and it presents a 50-phase over-segmented detection and a failed Baranyi fit as done, so it needs fixes before filing.
